SELECT composition_formula, prototype_label
FROM oqmd_entries
WHERE prototype_label IN ('L1₂', 'L12')
ORDER BY composition_formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT e.composition_formula
FROM oqmd_entries e
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM oqmd_element_ratios er
  WHERE er.entry_key = e.entry_key
    AND er.symbol = 'Ni'
)
ORDER BY e.composition_formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT entry_key, composition_formula, lattice_param_a
FROM oqmd_entries
WHERE lattice_param_a < 4
ORDER BY lattice_param_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT e.composition_formula, fe.gap_ev
FROM oqmd_formation_energies fe
JOIN oqmd_entries e ON oqmd_entries.entry_key = oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key
WHERE fe.gap_ev IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY fe.gap_ev DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS on_hull_compound_count
FROM oqmd_formation_energies
WHERE on_hull = TRUE
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT e.composition_formula, fe.delta_e
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE fe.delta_e < -0.5
ORDER BY fe.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  symbol,
  COUNT(DISTINCT entry_key) AS entry_count
FROM oqmd_element_ratios
GROUP BY symbol
ORDER BY entry_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    e.composition_formula,
    f.delta_e,
    f.hull_distance
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies f
    ON f.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE f.on_hull = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM oqmd_element_ratios r
      WHERE r.entry_key = e.entry_key
        AND r.symbol = 'Al'
  )
ORDER BY f.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  oqmd_entries.crystal_system,
  AVG(oqmd_formation_energies.delta_e) AS avg_eform
FROM oqmd_entries
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies
  ON oqmd_formation_energies.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
GROUP BY oqmd_entries.crystal_system
ORDER BY avg_formation_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS metastable_compound_count
FROM oqmd_formation_energies
WHERE hull_distance < 0.05
  AND on_hull = false
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT composition_formula
FROM oqmd_entries
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM oqmd_element_ratios er_ni
    WHERE er_ni.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
      AND er_ni.symbol = 'Ni'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM oqmd_element_ratios er_al
    WHERE er_al.entry_key = oqmd_entries.entry_key
      AND er_al.symbol = 'Al'
)
ORDER BY composition_formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT e.composition_formula,
       e.prototype_label,
       er.symbol AS a_site,
       fe.delta_e
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios er ON e.entry_key = er.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON e.entry_key = fe.entry_key
WHERE er.wyckoff_site = 'A-site'
  AND er.symbol = 'Co'
ORDER BY fe.delta_e ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT e.composition_formula,
       e.spacegroup_number,
       fe.gap_ev
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
WHERE e.spacegroup_number = 221
  AND fe.gap_ev > 0
ORDER BY fe.gap_ev DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  oqmd_reference_states.symbol,
  oqmd_elements.element_name,
  oqmd_reference_states.polymorph_count,
  oqmd_reference_states.gs_spacegroup
FROM oqmd_reference_states
JOIN oqmd_elements
  ON oqmd_elements.symbol = oqmd_reference_states.symbol
ORDER BY oqmd_reference_states.polymorph_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  oer.symbol,
  AVG(ofe.hull_distance) AS avg_hull_distance
FROM oqmd_element_ratios oer
JOIN oqmd_entries oe
  ON oer.entry_key = oe.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies ofe
  ON oe.entry_key = ofe.entry_key
WHERE oer.atomic_ratio = 0.75
GROUP BY oer.symbol
ORDER BY avg_hull_distance ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  e.composition_formula,
  fe.delta_e,
  (er_co.atomic_ratio * rs_co.reference_delta_e + er_ti.atomic_ratio * rs_ti.reference_delta_e) AS pure_element_reference_energy,
  (fe.delta_e - (er_co.atomic_ratio * rs_co.reference_delta_e + er_ti.atomic_ratio * rs_ti.reference_delta_e)) AS formation_enthalpy_from_pure_reference
FROM oqmd_entries e
JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios er_co ON er_co.entry_key = e.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_elements el_co ON el_co.symbol = er_co.symbol
JOIN oqmd_reference_states rs_co ON rs_co.symbol = el_co.symbol
JOIN oqmd_element_ratios er_ti ON er_ti.entry_key = e.entry_key
JOIN oqmd_elements el_ti ON el_ti.symbol = er_ti.symbol
JOIN oqmd_reference_states rs_ti ON rs_ti.symbol = el_ti.symbol
WHERE e.composition_formula = 'Co3Ti'
  AND er_co.symbol = 'Co'
  AND er_ti.symbol = 'Ti'
ORDER BY formation_enthalpy_from_pure_reference ASC
LIMIT 10000;

WITH rebased AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        e.composition_formula,
        fe.delta_e - SUM(er.atomic_ratio * rs.reference_delta_e) OVER (PARTITION BY e.entry_key, fe.fe_key) AS rebased_delta_e
    FROM oqmd_entries e
    JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
    JOIN oqmd_element_ratios er ON er.entry_key = e.entry_key
    JOIN oqmd_elements el ON el.symbol = er.symbol
    JOIN oqmd_reference_states rs ON rs.symbol = el.symbol
    WHERE fe.on_hull = TRUE
      AND e.prototype_label IN ('L12', 'L1₂', 'L1_2')
)
SELECT
    composition_formula,
    ROUND(rebased_delta_e::numeric, 4) AS rebased_delta_e
FROM rebased
WHERE rebased_delta_e < -0.3
ORDER BY rebased_delta_e ASC
LIMIT 10000;

WITH rereferenced AS (
  SELECT
    e.entry_key,
    a.symbol AS a_site,
    fe.delta_e - SUM(r.atomic_ratio * rs.reference_delta_e) AS rereferenced_formation_energy
  FROM oqmd_entries e
  JOIN oqmd_formation_energies fe
    ON fe.entry_key = e.entry_key
  JOIN oqmd_element_ratios a
    ON a.entry_key = e.entry_key
  JOIN oqmd_element_ratios r
    ON r.entry_key = e.entry_key
  JOIN oqmd_elements el
    ON el.symbol = r.symbol
  JOIN oqmd_reference_states rs
    ON rs.symbol = el.symbol
  WHERE (e.prototype_label = 'L12' OR e.prototype_label = 'L1_2' OR e.prototype_label = 'L1₂')
    AND fe.on_hull = TRUE
    AND a.wyckoff_site = 'A-site'
  GROUP BY e.entry_key, a.symbol, fe.delta_e
)
SELECT
  a_site_element,
  AVG(rereferenced_formation_energy) AS avg_rereferenced_formation_energy
FROM rereferenced
GROUP BY a_site_element
ORDER BY avg_rereferenced_formation_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;
